The '''D99-X Maintenance Droid''' was a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] equipped with two retractable [[Manipulator arm/Legends|heavy manipulators]]. Two D99-X droids were part of the [[Void Droid]]s inhabiting the [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]], and they carried [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]].
